HEADLINE: Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 33 of SEBI(LODR) Regulation, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Meeting of the Board of Directors of SEA TV NETWORK LIMITED was held today i.e., Wednesday, ....
MORE:
Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 33 of SEBI(LODR) Regulation, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Meeting of the Board of Directors of SEA TV NETWORK LIMITED was held today i.e., Wednesday, 04th November, 2026 through VC/OAVM. The meeting commenced at 04:15 PM (IST) and concluded at 05:16 PM (IST).
The Board of Directors, inter alia, considered and approved the following:
1.  Approval of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Second Quarter & Half Year ended  30th September, 2026
2. Accepted the resignation of M/s Ashutosh Agarwal & Co. from the position of Internal Auditor of the company.
3. Approved the appointment of M/s Singhal Manish & Associates as the Internal Auditor of the company
4. Authorization of Mr. Aman Khandelwal, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer as Authorized Representative before judicial, quasi-judicial and regulatory authorities and updation of compliance officer details with TRAI.

HEADLINE: Sea TV Network Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 04/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 1. The Unaudited Standalone ....
MORE:
Sea TV Network Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 04/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 1. The Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditors thereon.
2. To consider and accept the resignation of M/s. Ashutosh Agarwal & Co. from the position of Internal Auditor of the Company.
3. To consider and approve the appointment of M/s. Singhal Manish & Associates as the Internal Auditor of the Company for the Financial Year 2026-27.
4. To consider and approve the authorization of Mr. Aman Khandelwal, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer, to act as the Authorized Representative of the Company in pending and future cases before courts, tribunals, including TDSAT, and other regulatory authorities, and to update his particulars as Compliance Officer with the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI).
5. To consider any other matter with the permission of the Chair.
